title: Component ownership and recovery
description: A review workspace preserves accepted catalog data while a person edits an order, receives a clear authorization result, and recovers from a held or failed request.
alt: Two-panel component workbench with selectable catalog items, a review-order form, request and data status, an accepted receipt, and a disclosure for the semantic state twin.
caption: Figure 3. The component lab keeps accepted data on screen while local intent and authority move through their own validation, failure, and recovery states.
summary: Accepted catalog state, local form intent, request state, and authority receipt have distinct owners.

relationships.reading: Catalog revision and item availability remain visible
Email, quantity, and selected item stay editable until submission
Allowed, held, and denied remain explicit states
Prior accepted data remains available when a candidate fails or refreshes
